dict.string:
Wine Vault is a local-first cellar inventory for your home wine collection. Track bottles, quantities, vintages, regions, grapes, storage locations, and drink-by notes — entirely on your iPhone.
• Fully offline. Every record lives on your device. No account, no cloud database, no subscription. • Photos stay private. Optional label photos stay in the app's own storage and never leave your phone. • Value on demand. Opt-in price lookup returns dated reference quotes with their source — estimates with provenance, never authoritative prices; manual price entry always works offline. • Understand the collection. Drink-by timeline, dashboards by region and grape, and a value chart built only from your own stored quotes. • Your data, exportable. CSV export and ZIP backups — including photos — restore on a new device in one step. • No telemetry, no tracking, no data collected — confirmed by the app's own privacy manifest.
Browse the whole cellar — bottles, vintages, and locations, fully offline.
Request a dated value estimate only when you want one; confirm matches yourself.
See what's ready to drink on the drink-by timeline.
Export CSV or a ZIP backup with photos and restore it on a new device.
Two-column browsing on wide layouts — the same adaptive design on every device.
